close_reason: JMAP-ptl.20: fixed via clippy --fix. JMAP-ptl.21: labeled opinion, existing iterator chains are already good. JMAP-ptl.7: documented architectural choice — in-process filter chosen over query_objects delegation due to tree-mode complexity
description: mailbox.rs:196 handle_mailbox_query calls get_objects::<Mailbox>(None) to retrieve all mailboxes, then filters in-process. The MailBackend trait defines query_objects::<Mailbox> which backends can implement with an index, but the handler never calls it. For accounts with thousands of mailboxes (shared hosting, large organizations), every Mailbox/query allocates and deserializes the full mailbox list. Backends cannot improve Mailbox/query performance through their query_objects implementation because it is dead code from the handler's perspective.
title: Mailbox/query fetches all mailboxes in-process; backend query_objects<Mailbox> unreachable
